single.rationale: This clinical-stage biotech faces severe near-term headwinds: bitopertin received an FDA Complete Response Letter (CRL) in February 2026 after failed accelerated approval, cash declined from $192M to $91M in one year while operating cash burn accelerated to $180M annually, and dilution increased 28% year-over-year. With no revenue, mounting losses ($212M net loss in FY2025 vs $109M in FY2024), and cash runway only to 2029 even after a recent equity raise, the company faces significant execution risk and likely additional dilutive financing before any potential commercialization.

team.thesis: Disc Medicine is a pre-revenue clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company whose lead candidate bitopertin received an FDA Complete Response Letter in February 2026 rejecting accelerated approval after the FDA concluded trials did not show evidence of association between PPIX reduction and sunlight exposure endpoints, though the FDA confirmed bitopertin significantly lowers PPIX and indicated results
